qa.reason: Focused StopOutcome tests and isolated Android 17 actual Chat UI checks with synthetic Working status passed; pending/unconfirmed words remained visible. No real-turn stopping success, narrow/large-font, final signed runtime or Samsung verification claim.

notes.en:
Herdline 0.6.91 (Experimental, 10143)

- Chat's Working indicator is now a compact unframed line instead of a large outlined card: a small spinner, subdued status text and a trailing text-only Stop action.
- The top gap is reduced from 18dp to 6dp. Stop retains a 48dp touch target. Stop routing, disabled explanations, pending state and failure messages are unchanged.

Verification: focused StopOutcome tests and QA/test/signed builds passed. Actual Chat on an isolated Android 17 emulator was observed with synthetic Working status in an owned OMP fixture, in dark portrait with the keyboard hidden and shown. The row and Stop measured 48dp, without the card border or filled button. One Stop press on the idle fixture showed Stopping and then the fully visible unconfirmed result; this does not prove stopping a real model turn. No LLM calls. Narrow/large-font, final signed runtime and Samsung rendering were not separately exercised.
